title: Admin cum HR Executive
description:
Job Description – Admin Cum HR \& Accounts Executive

**Location:** S. Kolathur, Kovilambakkam, Chennai – 600129  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 1–3 Years  
**Qualification:** Any Degree / B.Com / BBA / MBA (HR) or equivalent  
**Salary:** ₹15,000 – ₹20,000 per month, depending on experience and skills

About REX Automation

REX Automation Pvt Ltd is an engineering and industrial automation company providing solutions in Industrial Automation, Electrical Engineering, Control Panels, Testing \& Commissioning, Operation \& Maintenance, Industrial Products Supply, Training \& Development, and Technical Manpower Supply.

We are looking for a responsible and organized **Admin Cum HR \& Accounts Executive** to manage day\-to\-day office administration, employee coordination, recruitment support, HR activities, and basic accounting functions.

Key Responsibilities1\. Office Administration

* Manage day\-to\-day office administration and general office activities.
* Maintain office records, files, documents and registers.
* Coordinate office supplies, stationery, courier and other administrative requirements.
* Coordinate with vendors, service providers and external agencies.
* Maintain employee and company documentation.
* Handle incoming and outgoing correspondence.
* Support management in day\-to\-day administrative activities.
* Maintain proper filing of physical and digital documents.

2\. HR \& Recruitment

* Coordinate recruitment activities for office and project/site requirements.
* Post job vacancies on recruitment portals and other relevant platforms.
* Source and screen candidates based on job requirements.
* Conduct initial candidate phone screening.
* Schedule interviews and coordinate with candidates and management.
* Maintain candidate database and recruitment status.
* Prepare and maintain employee joining documentation.
* Maintain employee personal files and HR records.
* Prepare appointment letters, offer letters and other HR documents.
* Maintain attendance, leave and employee records.
* Coordinate employee onboarding and exit formalities.
* Coordinate with site/project teams regarding manpower requirements.
* Support payroll\-related activities and salary inputs.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee and company information.

3\. Accounts \& Finance Support

* Handle day\-to\-day basic accounting activities.
* Record purchase and sales invoices.
* Maintain expenses, receipts and payment records.
* Prepare and maintain petty cash records.
* Verify bills, invoices and supporting documents.
* Coordinate with vendors regarding invoices and payments.
* Maintain accounts payable and receivable records.
* Follow up on outstanding payments and collections.
* Assist with bank\-related transactions and documentation.
* Maintain proper accounting records and supporting documents.
* Coordinate with the external Chartered Accountant / accounts consultant for accounting, GST, TDS and statutory requirements.
* Assist in preparing monthly accounting reports and MIS.

4\. Documentation \& MIS

* Maintain accurate employee, vendor, customer and company records.
* Prepare daily/weekly/monthly administrative and HR reports.
* Maintain recruitment trackers and employee databases.
* Prepare management reports as required.
* Ensure documents are properly organized and readily accessible.
* Maintain confidentiality and accuracy of company information.

Required Skills

* Good knowledge of **MS Excel and MS Word**.
* Basic knowledge of **Tally / accounting software** is preferred.
* Basic understanding of accounting principles.
* Good knowledge of office administration.
* Basic understanding of HR and recruitment processes.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good follow\-up and coordination skills.
* Ability to handle multiple responsibilities.
* Good documentation and record\-keeping skills.
* Ability to work independently with minimum supervision.
* Good attention to detail.
* Professional attitude and willingness to learn.

Preferred Experience

Candidates with experience in any of the following will be preferred:

* Engineering / Automation company
* Electrical / Electrical Contracting company
* Industrial company
* EPC company
* Manufacturing company
* Construction / Project company
* Technical manpower / manpower supply company

Experience in **recruitment, payroll coordination, vendor coordination and basic accounting** will be an added advantage.

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be:

* Responsible and trustworthy
* Well organized
* Proactive in follow\-ups
* Good at maintaining records
* Comfortable communicating with employees, candidates, vendors and customers
* Able to handle confidential information
* Willing to take ownership of administrative, HR and accounts activities
* Comfortable working in a growing startup environment

Important Note

This is a **multi\-functional role**. The selected candidate will be expected to independently handle day\-to\-day **Administration, HR coordination, Recruitment support and Basic Accounts activities** and coordinate with management and external professionals wherever required.

How to Apply

Interested candidates may send their **updated CV** along with:

* Current Location
* Total Experience
* Current Salary / CTC
* Expected Salary
* Notice Period / Earliest Joining Date
* Relevant experience in Admin / HR / Accounts

title: SAP HCM lead consultant
description:
Founded in 1976, CGI is among the world's largest independent IT and business consulting services firms. With 94,000 consultants and professionals globally, CGI delivers an end\-to\-end portfolio of capabilities, from strategic IT and business consulting to systems integration, managed IT and business process services, and intellectual property solutions. CGI works with clients through a local relationship model complemented by a global delivery network that helps clients digitally transform their organizations and accelerate results. CGI Fiscal 2024 reported revenue is CA$14\.68 billion, and CGI shares are listed on the TSX (GIB.A) and the NYSE (GIB). Learn more about us at cgi.com.  

  

Job Title: SAP HCM lead consultant  

Experience: 10\+ Years  

Job Location: Bangalore / Chennai / Hyderabad / Pune / Mumbai  

Position ID: J0926\-0309  

Work Type: Hybrid  

Employment Type: Full Time / Permanent  

Qualification: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.  

  

We are seeking an experienced SAP HCM Lead Consultant with 10\+ years of domain expertise to drive the design, implementation, governance, and support of our Human Capital Management landscape for project.  

  

In this role, you will act as the principal solution architect and team lead, bridging business requirements with SAP technical capabilities. You will bring rich SAP HCM Functional Knowledge to design end to end HR processes, build critical interfaces (especially Time \& Attendance), lead custom report development, and guide our S/4HANA implementation. The ideal candidate will serve as the strategic bridge between HR business stakeholders and IT technical teams, overseeing end to end module configuration, cross system integrations, data flows, and team leadership.  

  

Key Responsibilities
  

  

1\. End\-to\-End HCM Functional Ownership  

* Provide deep functional expertise across all primary SAP HCM processes (PA OM Time Management \& Payroll) evaluating HR business models and translating business requirements into optimal SAP functional designs.
* Lead solution design, system configuration, schema/rule modifications, and testing across Core HR: Personnel Administration (PA) and Organizational Management (OM).
* Act independently to determine solution methods, conduct impact assessments, and resolve complex architecture bottlenecks.
* Oversee integration with talent systems (Workday/SuccessFactors / Employee Central, Learning, Performance \& Goals).
* Design operational setups for support across Core HR (OM/PA), Time Management, Payroll, Employee Self\-Service (ESS) and Manager Self\-Service (MSS) platforms \& HR Reporting.
* S/4HANA Expertise: Direct functional experience designing and working within SAP S/4HANA environments.
* Deep Functional Expertise: Extensive, hands\-on functional mastery of PA, OM, Time Management, Payroll, and ESS/MSS workflows.

  

2\. Interface Building, Integrations \& Custom Reporting  

* Architect and oversee end\-to\-end custom Interface Building, specifically for Workday, external Time \& Attendance, and workforce management tools into SAP HCM.
* Design robust inbound/outbound integrations using APIs, middleware (SAP CPI/BTP/PI/PO), IDocs, and file\-based (SFTP) protocols.
* Lead custom HR Report Building (Ad\-hoc Query, SAP Query, ABAP spec design) and data extraction frameworks for operational and executive reporting.
* Apply functional understanding of adjacent module touchpoints (such as HR\-FI payroll postings, cost centers, symbolic accounts) to maintain cross\-system integrity.

  

3\. Team \& Project Leadership  

* Serve as the overall functional lead for the SAP HCM track, owning deliverable quality, architecture decisions, and project timelines.
* Lead blueprinting, functional specification reviews, change management, and SIT/UAT testing phases.
* Mentor functional consultants, partner with HR Leadership, and conduct regular governance reviews with implementation partners.

  

CGI is an equal opportunity employer. In addition, CGI is committed to providing accommodations for people with disabilities in accordance with provincial legislation. Please let us know if you require a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during any aspect of the recruitment process and we will work with you to address your needs.  

  

\#LI\-GB9**Your future duties and responsibilities**

**Required qualifications to be successful in this role**

**Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.**  

  

Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…  

  

You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.  

  

Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.  

  

You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well\-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.
  

  

That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.  

  

Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

description:
We are looking for a dynamic and result\-oriented Talent Acquisition Executive to manage end\-to\-end recruitment activities, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, salary negotiation, and candidate closure. The role requires strong knowledge of job portals, recruitment strategies, ATS/ERP systems, and high\-volume hiring. The ideal candidate should be able to hire 80–100 candidates per month, maintain a strong talent pipeline, manage recruitment TAT and hiring cost data, and be willing to travel across India for recruitment requirements.

**What we Offer?**

* Absolute clarity on work expectations and number\-based appraisal system
* Company is growing 10X in next 4 years, so a superb growth opportunity for people contributing towards growth of company.
* Stable company with clear laid down procedures, and a great track record of growth.
* Pan India operations so scope of moving across India to gain multiple experience in various geographies.
* Job Security with cash rich, well\-funded company listed on NSE with market cap of 600 Crores.
* Professional work culture and learning environment, where the only pressure is of upgrading your skillset and growing along with organization.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Handle end\-to\-end recruitment from sourcing to candidate onboarding.
* Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, referrals, social media, and other recruitment channels.
* Screen resumes, conduct HR interviews, and coordinate interviews with hiring managers.

* Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline for current and future hiring requirements.
* Negotiate salary, influence candidates, and ensure successful offer acceptance and joining.

* Draft professional emails for candidate communication, interview scheduling, offers, and follow\-ups.
* Coordinate with hiring managers and stakeholders to ensure timely position closures.
* Travel across India for recruitment drives, campus hiring, walk\-in interviews, and business hiring requirements.

**✅ Desired Candidate Profile:**

* Strong knowledge of job portals (Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, Workindia, etc.) and sourcing strategies.
* Proven ability to close positions within defined TAT.
* Experience in high\-volume hiring (80–100 hires per month preferred).
* Excellent salary negotiation, candidate influencing, and stakeholder management skills.
* Good knowledge of ATS/Recruitment Software/ERP systems.
* Strong email drafting, MS Excel, and reporting skills.
* Ability to build and maintain a quality candidate database and talent pipeline.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and time management skills.
* Willingness to travel across India for recruitment activities.

OR

* Assists with coordination and facilitation of new hire orientation program to generate a positive first impression for employees and emphasize the importance of guest service in company culture.


* Ensures attendance by all new hires and participation of the leadership team in training programs

* Partners with Loss Prevention to conduct employee accident investigations, as necessary.


* Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position.

* Assists with ensuring employee files contain required employment paperwork, proper performance management and compensation documentation, are properly maintained and secured for the required length of time.


* Assists with ensuring compliance with procedure for accessing, reviewing, and auditing employee files and ensure compliance with the Privacy Act.


* Assists with ensuring medical records are maintained in a separate, secure and confidential medical file.


* Facilitates random, reasonable belief and post accident drug testing process (in properties where applicable).


* Communicates property rules and regulations via the employee handbook.


* Assists with ensuring all safety and security policies (e.g., property removal, lost and found items, blood borne pathogens, accident reporting, and hygiene) are communicated to employees on a regular basis through orientation, property meetings, bulletin boards, etc.


* Assists with periodic claims reviews with Regional Claims office to ensure claims are closed in a timely manner and reserve levels are appropriate for open claims.


* Assists with managing Workers Compensation claims to ensure appropriate employee care and manage costs.

description:
**Assistant Manager\- HRBP** 

Location: Royapettah, Chennai

**About MrMed**

MrMed is a fast\-growing digital healthcare platform committed to making specialty and life\-saving medicines accessible and affordable across India. We support patients battling chronic and critical illnesses by simplifying access to high\-cost therapies and providing end\-to\-end assistance throughout their treatment journey.

At MrMed, we work closely across multiple teams including warehouse operations, logistics, billing, and city operations to ensure timely and safe delivery of medicines to patients. Our operations team plays a critical role in maintaining accuracy, speed, and quality across the supply chain.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a dynamic and hands\-on \*\*HR Business Partner (HRBP)\*\* to own the end\-to\-end HR process for our operations teams — including warehouse, logistics, billing, and city operations. This role requires someone who can work closely with business leaders and frontline teams on the ground, driving hiring, employee engagement, performance management, and compliance, while ensuring HR practices support the speed and accuracy that our supply chain demands.

The ideal candidate is a strong communicator who can balance people\-first thinking with business priorities, and who is comfortable operating in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment.

**Roles \& Responsibilities**

**Talent Acquisition \& Onboarding**

* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment for operations roles — sourcing, screening, interviewing, and closing positions within defined timelines
* Coordinate smooth onboarding and induction for new hires across warehouse, logistics, billing, and city operations teams

**Employee Relations \& Engagement**

* Act as the first point of contact for employee queries, grievances, and concerns
* Drive employee engagement initiatives to improve morale, retention, and workplace culture
* Conduct regular floor/site visits to stay connected with ground\-level teams

**Performance Management**

* Support goal\-setting, performance reviews, and appraisal cycles in coordination with department heads
* Identify performance gaps and work with managers on improvement plans

**HR Operations \& Compliance**

* Maintain accurate employee records, attendance, and HRMS data
* Ensure compliance with statutory requirements (PF, ESI, labour laws, etc.) relevant to operations staff
* Handle documentation for joining, confirmation, transfers, and exits

**Policy Implementation \& Advisory**

* Roll out and reinforce HR policies, processes, and code of conduct across teams
* Partner with business leaders to advise on workforce planning, org structure, and people decisions

**Learning \& Development**

* Identify training needs for operations staff and coordinate relevant learning interventions
* Support skill\-building programs to improve efficiency and safety on the ground

**Exit Management**

* Manage the full exit process including exit interviews, clearance, and full \& final settlement coordination

**Qualifications**

* MBA/PGDM in Human Resources or related field
* Minimum 5 years of experience as an HRBP or HR Generalist, preferably supporting operations, warehouse, logistics, or blue\-collar/frontline workforce teams
* Strong understanding of Indian labour laws and statutory compliance
* Hands\-on experience with HRMS tools and MS Office/Excel
* Excellent interpersonal, communication, and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to work on the ground with cross\-functional and frontline teams
* Comfortable working from office in a fast\-paced, high\-growth startup environment

At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.



Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

  

  

**Job Description**  


  

The HRIS Specialist \- Oracle HCM Functional Specialist will serve as a functional subject matter expert (SME) for the Oracle Human Resources Management System (HRMS) platform, with primary responsibility for the configuration, optimization, support, and expansion of HR technology capabilities across a multinational operating environment. This role will lead the design, testing, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of Oracle HRMS solutions and act as a key partner to HR, IT, Payroll, and business stakeholders. The ideal candidate brings deep, hands\-on Oracle HRMS expertise and a strong track record supporting global HR processes across Core HR, Oracle Recruiting Cloud (ORC), Compensation, Benefits, Talent Management, and related modules.  


  

**What You Will Do:**  


  

* Serve as the primary functional SME for Oracle Human Resources Management System (HRMS) and provide day\-to\-day support, configuration, enhancement, and optimization across key HR modules.
* Lead system design, configuration, testing, implementation, troubleshooting, and production support activities for Oracle HRMS in a multinational environment.
* Partner with HR, Payroll, IT, and business stakeholders to gather requirements, translate business needs into scalable Oracle HRMS solutions, and recommend best\-practice system designs.
* Support and optimize Oracle HRMS modules, including Core HR, Oracle Recruiting Cloud (ORC), Compensation, Benefits, Talent Management, and related modules.
* Research, configure, and document solutions that address global business requirements, local country requirements, and process standardization opportunities.
* Coordinate and support system upgrades, patches, releases, and enhancements, including impact assessments, test strategy, regression testing, user acceptance testing, and deployment readiness.
* Maintain system configuration, tables, security roles, workflow setup, and related controls to ensure system reliability, usability, and compliance.
* Develop, validate, and support reports, dashboards, and analytics that enable HR decision\-making and improve operational visibility.
* Ensure data integrity through audits, controls, interface monitoring, issue resolution, and process improvements.
* Train and support end users, HR users, and other stakeholders on reporting, system functionality, and process changes.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that increase efficiency, improve user experience, and strengthen HR operational effectiveness through Oracle HRMS.

**What You Will Need:**  


  

**Education and Experience**
* BA/BS in MIS, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, Human Resources, or a related field preferred.
* **Significant progressive HRIS experience with strong hands\-on functional expertise in Oracle HRMS, including configuration, enhancements, implementations, testing, and production support.**
* Experience supporting global or multinational HR operations and country\-specific process requirements preferred.
* Experience supporting HR and/or Payroll systems, self\-service platforms, and related integrations preferred.

**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**
* **Deep functional expertise in** **Oracle HRMS configuration, workflows, security, testing, troubleshooting, system maintenance, upgrades, and release support.**
* Strong knowledge of Oracle HRMS business processes across Core HR, recruiting, compensation, benefits, talent, time and labor, and payroll\-related workflows.
* Ability to translate business requirements into scalable, sustainable Oracle HRMS solutions with strong attention to process design and user impact.
* Experience supporting system implementations, upgrades, and large\-scale enhancements in a complex business environment.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and data validation skills, with the ability to identify root causes and resolve system and process issues effectively.
* Advanced reporting skills, including the ability to work with large data sets and complex Microsoft Excel functions
* Strong customer\-facing, consulting, and communication skills with the ability to work effectively across HR, IT, Payroll, and business teams.
* Working knowledge of data governance, privacy, and control requirements related to HR data.
* Experience in a high\-volume, transactional environment preferred.
* Oracle HRMS reporting, dashboarding, and analytics experience preferred.

  

  

  

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

title: HR Manager
description:
HR Manager – Life Insurance

**Candidate from Tier\-1 / premier B\-Schools or reputed campuses only preferred**.

**Industry:** Life Insurance  
**Position:** HR Manager  
**Experience:** 5–10 years  
**Education:** MBA/PGDM in Human Resources preferred  
**Campus Preference:** Candidates from **Tier\-1 / reputed B\-Schools and premier institutions preferred**

Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced **HR Manager** to manage and drive key HR functions within the Life Insurance business. The role will involve **talent acquisition, employee engagement, performance management, HR operations, learning \& development, and business partnering**, with a strong focus on supporting sales and business teams.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage end\-to\-end **HR operations** for the assigned business unit/region.
* Partner with business leaders to understand workforce requirements and develop appropriate HR strategies.
* Drive **talent acquisition and manpower planning**, particularly for sales and distribution teams.
* Manage recruitment, onboarding, induction, and employee lifecycle processes.
* Develop and implement strategies for **employee engagement, retention, and workforce productivity**.
* Handle **performance management, goal setting, appraisals, and performance improvement initiatives**.
* Identify training and development requirements and coordinate relevant **L\&D programs**.
* Support managers in handling employee grievances, disciplinary matters, and workplace issues.
* Monitor employee attrition and implement initiatives to improve **employee retention**.
* Ensure compliance with company HR policies, processes, and applicable employment regulations.
* Prepare and analyze HR dashboards and reports covering **headcount, attrition, hiring, productivity, and employee engagement**.
* Support organizational change initiatives and ensure effective communication across teams.
* Act as a strategic **HR Business Partner** to business and functional leaders.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* MBA/PGDM in **Human Resources** from a reputed institution.
* Candidates from **Tier\-1 / premier B\-Schools or reputed campuses are preferred**.
* 5–10 years of relevant HR experience, preferably in **Life Insurance, BFSI, Insurance, Banking, or Financial Services**.
* Strong experience in **HRBP, talent acquisition, employee engagement, performance management, and HR operations**.
* Experience supporting **sales/distribution teams** will be an added advantage.
* Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder\-management, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work in a **fast\-paced, target\-driven business environment**.

Pay: ₹900,000\.00 \- ₹1,200,000\.00 per year

Education:

* Master's (Preferred)

Work Location: In person
